positions.title: Product Developer
positions.description:
Supervised development, maintenance, support, and quality assurance on multiple applications improving workflows with document management systems for legal firms around the world

Participated in Sales meetings to understand and translate user needs into solutions

Developed front-end components with WPF using XAML and back-end components using C# .NET and connected them using WPF bindings and JSON converters

Gathered and converted requirements into technical specifications recorded in Gitlab for DevOps and issue-tracking

Integrated external technologies such as Active Directory for authentication/authorization and third-party REST APIs for retrieving and manipulating data via C#

Currently learning/using ASP.NET Core, Razor Pages, MVC, and Electron.js to create prototype desktop progressive web app applications.

positions.title: Digital Marketing Contractor
positions.description:
Lead development of a business intelligence solution aggregating all company’s data sources under one medium for interactive data visualization using Microsoft Power BI to produce new insights and make better decisions

Performed investigations and made appropriate suggestions on various BI services and ETL software to meet development efforts and tutored on how to use the software

Retrieved data using Supermetrics and stored in a containers queried via ODBC

Recreated popular metrics such as Cost per Click and Conversion Rate with DAX scripting

Developed an Azure Active Directory registered web application using ASP.NET Web Forms, Bootstrap and Power BI’s REST API to present the data
